sentences.text: The documents do not state whether a Tier 3 UCB may open a new branch in another state without RBI’s prior approval.

The only branch-related text provided says a UCB may make arrangements in affected areas by setting up satellite offices, extension counters or mobile banking facilities etc. under intimation to Reserve Bank, and it also says small accounts may be opened in such cases.
The provided directions apply to all UCBs and say a UCB shall be guided by RBI instructions, but they do not state any rule here for opening a new branch in another state or for prior approval.
